issues: This repo should not have been eligible. The README says the lite pipeline needs 22 GB VRAM (18 GB with --save_memory) and installs CUDA wheels (cu121), pytorch3d and nvdiffrast. The examiner's 'device is a flag, so CPU is plausible' was a guess that the README contradicts.
The code ties the reconstruction stage to CUDA: SVRM mesh export uses context_type='cuda' -> nvdiffrast RasterizeCudaContext, plus hard .cuda() calls and .half() weights.
The README has no CPU-feasible demo (every inference path goes through mvd + svrm), so no replacement exam is proposed.
